text: Online aesthetic evaluation by multiple people (scale 1–10)
description: Admin/evaluator area of the website. Each evaluator rates every painting 1–10 on aesthetics only, with a clear note that size is applied as a separate factor on top. Shows each evaluator their list of not-yet-evaluated paintings. Average across evaluators = aesthetic price factor.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: A to-do list gets every evaluator to rate all ~100 paintings, so averages are complete
Explicitly separating aesthetics from size prevents evaluators from double-counting size in the price
